tools.name: ask_hirepulse_advisor
tools.description: Free advisor that maps a goal (B2B leads, hiring signals, buying intent, tech stack, Google Ads, due diligence) to the matching HirePulse tool, its price, the free-call balance and a ready-to-run request. Use when the right tool or expected cost is unclear; go directly to get_company_profile for a k

tools.name: detect_website_tech_stack
tools.description: Website tech stack for a company domain: ad pixels (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok), analytics, tag managers, CMS, e-commerce, hosting and payments, plus email provider, SPF and DMARC from DNS. $0.005 per result after 5 free calls a day; blocked or empty sites are free. Use for technology-only r

tools.name: get_company_open_jobs
tools.description: Live open jobs for a company domain from its public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters board: titles, departments, locations, remote flag and salary when published. Up to 300 jobs; known_job_ids returns new and closed jobs. $0.01; no board or no open jobs is free. Use f

tools.name: get_company_hiring_intent
tools.description: Hiring-based buying-intent score (0-100) for a company domain from its public job board: hiring status, open roles, roles posted in the last 30 days, hiring by function and technologies hired for. $0.01 per result; no board or no open jobs is free. Use to prioritize a known company by hiring signals

tools.name: get_google_ads_by_domain
tools.description: Google Ads for a company domain from the public Ads Transparency Center: whether it advertises, the Google ad count estimate and up to 40 ads with format, first and last shown dates and links. Optional region filter. $0.01 per result; no ads is free. Use for public competitor advertising evidence; t

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: One-call company profile for a domain: tech stack, hiring intent, Google Ads and published contacts (emails, social links, MX), run in parallel, with plain-language signals and a breakout_summary growth estimate. $0.03, charged only when at least two of the four sections have data. Counts as one of

tools.name: extract_company_contacts
tools.description: Published contacts for a company domain from its home, about, contact, team and careers pages: deduplicated emails and LinkedIn, X and GitHub links, plus MX, SPF and DMARC checks (not mailbox verification). $0.01; nothing found is free.

tools.name: claim_free_trial
tools.description: Get a one-time trial pass: 25 free successful calls of any single tool, not tied to your IP, valid 30 days. Send exactly one of: a Base wallet that has activity, or a work email (no email is sent). Then pass the token as params._meta["hirepulse/trial_token"] or the X-Trial-Token header.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_company_hiring_intent" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?profile=b2b&ref=registry-b2b" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_profile, claim_free_trial · Private data: detect_website_tech_stack, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, extract_company_contacts, claim_free_trial · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, claim_free_trial · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_profile, claim_free_trial · Private data: detect_website_tech_stack, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, extract_company_contacts, claim_free_trial · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, claim_free_trial · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
